<div class="card-body">
'''Feltipern Trevagg''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊フェルティパーン・トレヴァッグ</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">トレヴァッグのいる位置で戦闘を始めるためには、プレイヤーはＸフォース消費しなければならない。Ｘは、そこにある［ダークサイド］アイコンと［ライトサイド］アイコンの数である。ドロイドが、そこにいる場合、このルールは適用されない。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ゴウタル男性の腐敗した徴税人。バウンティ・ハンター。賞金首のオビ＝ワンを追っていた。放射を感知してドロイドを追跡できる。ミーユム・オニスに惚れている。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Feltipern Trevagg.

'''Card text:''' To start a battle at Trevagg's location, a player must use X Force, where X is the number of dark-side and light-side Force icons there. If a droid is there, this rule does not apply.

'''Lore:''' A corrupt male Gotal tax collector and bounty hunter who pursued the bounty on Obi-Wan. He can sense emissions to track droids. He is in love with M'iiyoom Onith.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says he can track droids by sensing emissions, while the English says his ability to sense droid emanations is limited. The Japanese says he is in love with M'iiyoom Onith; the English says he romanced her.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Feltipern Trevagg]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=166s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 2:46.</ref>
